name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
  ai.item AS "Add-on Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
  COUNT(*) AS "Sold Count:Int:120"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` ai
INNER JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket` t
  ON t.name = ai.parent
WHERE
  ai.parenttype = 'Airplane Ticket'
  AND t.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY ai.item
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
